race.comment: QUEEN DIVA (11) makes her debut with enough positive trial evidence to be treated as the horse to beat, having won an easy Belmont heat after two earlier lead-ups. The Parnham and Miller combination adds polish and she maps to get every chance on debut. Can make an immediate impact. LONDON ROSE (8) jumped an odds-on fave last start after bolting in at Northam first-up. Drawn better this time as Tsang hops back aboard and she looks set to bounce back third-up. HANSADIOS (10) resumes after a sound debut third on heavy ground at Belmont and has since won a Belmont trial. Looks set for a strong showing on resumption. GOD'S RAPTURE (3) resumes in an easier level and can be thereabouts.
